sources.entry: Build a Laravel CRUD Application From Scratch

summary.title: Laravel CRUD Demo With Resource Controller Tutorial
summary.one_liner: You learn to build a complete Laravel CRUD student-records app using a resource controller, Blade layouts, MySQL migrations and Bootstrap views.
keywords: build crud app from scratch php
takeaways: Set up a fresh Laravel project with Composer, point Apache at the public folder, and configure MySQL in .env
Use Blade master layouts, partials and @yield/@extends to share header, footer and Bootstrap assets across views
Create a students migration and model with a fillable array for mass assignment
Generate a resource controller with php artisan make:controller --resource and implement index, create, store, show, edit, update and destroy
Wire up Route::resource and build index, create, show and edit views with validation error display
summary.summary: This step-by-step tutorial walks through building a Students CRUD application in Laravel, starting from a fresh project install under XAMPP. It covers Blade layout and partial files with Bootstrap, a MySQL database created through a custom artisan command, and a students migration and model. It then generates a resource controller, implements its seven methods with validation, and registers them with a single Route::resource line. The page is partway through the views section when the text ends; the edit view and later sections are not in the supplied text.
